definitions.meaning: A decree (? cf. ge-sceádan; II. 3), decision (?)

quotations.old_english: Wé þæs náne bysne nabbað, ne on bóca gesceádnyssum (in auctoritate scripturarum), ne on háligra fædera hǽsum

source_text: ge-sceádness, e; f. A decree (? cf. ge-sceádan; II. 3), decision (?) :-- Wé þæs náne bysne nabbað, ne on bóca gesceádnyssum (in auctoritate scripturarum), ne on háligra fædera hǽsum, Nap. 32, l.
